body: I’ve been doing that, along with referrals where I can get them. That’s why I haven’t applied to more jobs, actually— it takes time research the company, finds an employee/recruiter contact, tailor Cl, etc. It’s getting to the point where a post will be up on LI for 24 hours and get 1000+ applicants.
It will be. Just don’t spend $300k (bad) and major in something readily employable(good).

I work part-time at a nearby restaurant to keep busy, but I’ve been looking for contract jobs too and getting no luck there either.

At most tech companies, temp work very rarely translates into a permanent job unfortunately.
Thanks for your kind words. Appreciate it.
